definitions.explanation: Gold in its purest form without alloy metals mixed in. In the jewelry industry, 24-karat gold (99.99% purity) is considered pure gold.

examples.japanese: この{指輪|ゆびわ}は{純金|じゅんきん}でできている。
examples.english: This ring is made of pure gold.

examples.japanese: {純金|じゅんきん}の{価格|かかく}が{過去最高|かこさいこう}を{記録|きろく}した。
examples.english: The price of pure gold hit a record high.

examples.japanese: {純金|じゅんきん}は{柔|やわ}らかいので、{日常|にちじょう}のアクセサリーには{合金|ごうきん}が{使|つか}われることが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Pure gold is soft, so alloys are often used for everyday accessories.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{純|じゅん} (pure) + {金|きん} (gold)

USAGE:
Pure gold is 24 karat (24K), meaning 99.99% purity. Common alloys include 18K ({十八金|じゅうはちきん}) and 14K ({十四金|じゅうよんきん}). {純金|じゅんきん} is too soft for everyday jewelry, so alloys are standard for rings and necklaces.

FIGURATIVE:
Can also mean something genuine or of the highest quality, similar to English "pure gold."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {純金|じゅんきん}{製|せい}: made of pure gold
- {純金|じゅんきん}の{延|の}べ{棒|ぼう}: gold bar, gold ingot
- {純金|じゅんきん}{積立|つみたて}: gold savings plan
- {純金|じゅんきん}{相場|そうば}: pure gold market price

RELATED TERMS:
- {金|きん}: gold (general)
- {合金|ごうきん}: alloy
- {金箔|きんぱく}: gold leaf
